name: datavisualizer
title: Data Visualizer
description: Live tables and charts over your data: SQL or app tables, filtered from the UI.

operations.name: open
operations.description: Compose the app surface listing every view; input "docked" skips the window.

operations.name: show
operations.description: Create a view from JSON {title, kind: table|chart, source: sql|apptable:<id>, sql, filters: [outputColumn], refreshSeconds}. SQL is a SELECT without a row limit; the app applies equality filters with bound parameters before its 200-row display limit. Charts use the first output column as labels and the second as numeric values. The view id is derived from the request id; the table or chart neuron holds the result.

operations.name: refine
operations.description: Set visible equality filters and optionally replace SQL: JSON {view, filters: {outputColumn: value}, sql, linkFiltersTo}. New filter columns become controls. Empty values clear filters. Optional linkFiltersTo is an existing view id whose same-named declared filters should be shared; changing either control refreshes both views. Prefer filters over embedding filter values in SQL. Optional filterColumns replaces the control list (empty removes all); SQL columns and value types are validated before saving.

operations.name: read
operations.description: Refresh a view: input is the view id. The result is the view's table or chart neuron.

operations.name: close
operations.description: Remove a view and its window: input is the view id.

operations.name: refresh
operations.description: Refresh current source data and filter values; input is a view id or empty for all views.
